cohort: The study included 767 women who underwent an emergency caesarean section during labor.
finding: The type of hysterotomy extension (transverse vs. cephalocaudal traction) did not significantly influence the rate or type of intraoperative complications in emergency caesarean sections.
mod_finding: The chosen method of hysterotomy extension during emergency caesarean section did not significantly impact intraoperative complication rates.
